**项目路径**: /root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination

```bash
# 查看 C4 seed data 格式作为参考
```


"""Download arXiv abstracts via arXiv API (no HuggingFace dependency).

import json
import os
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

os.environ["REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE"] = "/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"
os.environ["SSL_CERT_FILE"] = "/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

docs = []
offset = 0
categories = ["cs.CL", "cs.LG", "cs.AI", "cs.CV", "stat.ML"]
query = "+OR+".join([f"cat:{c}" for c in categories])

print(f"Fetching arXiv abstracts from categories: {categories}")
print(f"Target: {TARGET} abstracts")

while len(docs) < TARGET:
    url = f"http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query={query}&start={offset}&max_results={BATCH}&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending"
    print(f"  Fetching offset={offset}, batch={BATCH}...")
    
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "exp024-arxiv-seed/1.0"})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
                xml_data = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
            break

            print(f"    Attempt {attempt+1} failed: {e}")
            if attempt < 2:
                time.sleep(5)

                print("    Giving up on this batch")

    entries = root.findall(f"{ARXIV_NS}entry")

        break

        abstract = summary_el.text.strip()
        abstract = " ".join(abstract.split())
        if len(abstract) < MIN_CHARS:
            continue
        docs.append({"text": abstract, "doc_id": len(docs)})
        if len(docs) >= TARGET:
            break
    
    print(f"  Collected {len(docs)}/{TARGET}")
    offset += BATCH
    time.sleep(3)  # arXiv API rate limit: 1 req per 3 seconds

print(f"\nTotal collected: {len(docs)} abstracts")
if len(docs) == 0:
    print("FAILED: No abstracts collected!")
    sys.exit(1)
